title: How to Edit a Project
summary: Update an existing project's details, funding, contacts, and images.

steps.title: Access the project edit button
steps.body: After logging in, go to the Projects page. Search for a specific project or filter by your organization to view associated projects, then click Edit next to the project you want to update.

steps.title: Update the project name
steps.body: For example, to update the project name, edit the Project Name field.

steps.title: Confirm and save changes
steps.body: A confirmation dialog will appear showing the changes made. Click Confirm and Save. Saving may take a few moments while your changes are processed.

steps.title: View the post-save confirmation
steps.body: Once the update is complete, a confirmation message will appear showing that the project has been successfully updated.
